name: Sunlord-sdcl
title: SDCL-D series multilayer chip ceramic inductors for RF, 0402 and 0603
summary: Monolithic multilayer chip inductors with a ceramic body, meant for RF circuits in telecom and similar equipment. The SDCL1005 (0402) range runs from 0.6 nH to 360 nH and the SDCL1608 (0603) range from 1.0 nH to 680 nH. Each value has a minimum Q, typical Q at 100, 800 and 1000 MHz, minimum self-resonant frequency, maximum DC resistance and rated current. Small values are toleranced in nH (±0.1 to ±0.3 nH), larger ones in percent (±3 to ±10 %).

tables.title: Part number code
notes: In the inductance code, N stands for nH and also marks the decimal point; R is a decimal point in front of the digits, counted in µH (R10 = 0.10 µH = 100 nH).
Example: SDCL1608C10NJTDF is a 1608-size, 10 nH, ±5 % part on tape and reel.

tables.title: SDCL1005-D electrical characteristics
notes: The □ in each part number is the tolerance letter, picked by the buyer: B (±0.1 nH), C (±0.2 nH) or S (±0.3 nH) for values up to 6.2 nH; H (±3 %), J (±5 %) or K (±10 %) for values above 6.2 nH.
A dash means no typical Q is given at that frequency.

tables.title: SDCL1608-D electrical characteristics
notes: The □ in each part number is the tolerance letter, picked by the buyer: B (±0.1 nH), C (±0.2 nH) or S (±0.3 nH) for values up to 6.2 nH; H (±3 %), J (±5 %) or K (±10 %) for values above 6.2 nH.
Parts marked * (120 nH and up) are 1.65±0.15 mm long; the rest of the SDCL1608 range is 1.60±0.15 mm.
A dash means no typical Q is given at that frequency.

operation.text: A monolithic multilayer ceramic chip with high reliability, good solderability and high resistance to soldering heat.
For RF circuits in telecommunication and other equipment. The self-resonant frequency is high.

Up to 6.2 nH the tolerance is an absolute figure: B, C or S for ±0.1, ±0.2 or ±0.3 nH. Above 6.2 nH it is relative: H, J or K for ±3, ±5 or ±10 %. The letter goes in the fifth field of the part number.
Inductance and Q are specified at 100 MHz for most values; the SDCL1005 parts at 330 nH and 360 nH and the SDCL1608 parts from 120 nH up are specified at 50 MHz.
SDCL1005 parts of 10 nH and below carry a mark on the top face. SDCL1005 parts of 12 nH and above, and every SDCL1608 part, are unmarked.
